sections.Profile:
"Majestic" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1957. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, it was the first pinball machine to feature disk roto-targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Pageantry, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
